title: Skin Care for Teachers: Chalk Dust, Sun Duty and Dry Hands
ex: A short routine for school teachers in India: chalk dust and dry hands, sunscreen for assembly and ground duty, dry lips, a staffroom kit and busy-night care.
rt: Skin Care for Teachers: Simple School-Day Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for teachers in India: dry hands from chalk dust, sunscreen for assembly and ground duty, lip care, a staffroom kit and a 3-step night routine.
quick: Teachers mainly need a hand cream for chalk-dried fingers, sunscreen before school for assembly and duty, a lip balm for long talking hours, and a short night routine. Wash, moisturise and apply sunscreen in the morning; cleanse, apply night cream, hand cream and lip balm at night.
facts: Chalk dust mostly dries the skin on fingers
Assembly and ground duty add up to real sun exposure
Talking for hours dries the lips
A 3-step night routine is enough on busy nights
